payload.title: File:Phosphatotitan khouribgaensis (holotype, caudal vertebra - drawing).png
payload.artist_html: N. R. Lonrich, A. Pérez-Moreno, V. Díez Díaz, X. Pereda-Suberbiola, N. Bardet & N.-E. Jalil
payload.credit_html: "A titanosaurian sauropod with South American affinities (Lognkosauria: Argentinosauridae) from the Late Maastrichtian of Morocco and evidence for dinosaur endemism in Africa"
payload.description_html: Phosphatotitan khouribgaensis, MHNM.KHG.888, holotype; Sidi Chennane, Oulad Abdoun Basin, Khouribga Province, Morocco; phosphates, lower Couche III, late Maastrichtian. Proximal caudal vertebra of MHNM.KHG.888, holotype in (A) posterior; (B) anterior; (C) right lateral view. Abbreviations: cen, centrum; con, condyle; cot, cotyle; nec, neural canal; nsp, neural spine; poz, postzygapophysis; pne, pneumatopore; prz, prezygapophyses; psl, postspinal lamina; tp, transverse process.
